rules.note: Scan of the passport page with your personal data. The passport must be a document that allows you to cross borders.

First-cycle (bachelor) diploma from a programme country, as a scan of the original. If you have not graduated yet, upload the university certificate NAWA describes (name, programme, completion date, average grade, stamp).
Diploma supplement showing your average grade for the whole course and the grades for each subject. Documents not in Polish or English need a certified translation.

Proof that you are in the admission process for full-time master's studies at a Polish university (admission decision, acceptance letter, registration confirmation or university reply). Not needed for the Polish-language path.
Proof of the language you will study in: Polish B2 or English B2 for full studies, or Polish B1 for the one-year preparatory course. Accepted certificates are in the call's appendices.
Video self-presentation in Polish or English, 1 to 3 minutes, explaining why you chose your field and want to study in Poland. No other people may appear in it.
Optional letter of recommendation from a Polish diplomatic mission for your region. You may include it but you do not have to.
Not listed in the official requirements.
